title: Lyn Buchanan met with an alien as a remote viewer

tellings.quote: Lynn Buchanan, who I've known for a long time, the Army remote viewer. Yeah. He told me like I don't know eight or nine years ago that he had met with an alien.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, who worked for the Army as a remote viewer, someone trained to try to perceive distant places and things with the mind alone, once said he had met with an alien. The writer Greg Bishop, who says he has known Buchanan a long time, tells Michels that Buchanan told him this "eight or nine years ago", around 2016, and relays it second-hand without saying where the meeting happened.
